variant_name: growth by edit (plain host, then one edit turn)
prompt: Silhouette: Four-legged axolotl frame. Host frame: the axolotl sets the outline, body size and overall frame. A single axolotl. Head of the axolotl, fully visible and uncluttered, with clear, discernible eyes. Details: axolotl body and legs, with its own smooth skin everywhere, plain coat. Bilaterally symmetrical, recognizable limbs, visible sense organs. Habitat cue (river forest): dark back and light belly (mild countershading). Prosaic detail: natural lighting, feet in firm contact with the ground with a soft shadow, normal wear on hooves, claws and skin. One creature, full body, side three-quarter view, plain light background, natural history illustration.
edit_instruction: Grow, from the skin of the back and flanks, a covering of large overlapping keratin scales in its own colors that replaces the axolotl's smooth skin over the back and flanks: it grows in the skin as the axolotl's own covering there, not as pieces added on top; the smooth skin stops at the covering's edge, and the belly and legs keep the axolotl's own smooth skin; the scales are a pangolin's scale layer grown in the skin: overlapping keratin scales rooted in the skin like a pangolin's, in rows that overlap from head to tail like roof tiles, one continuous layer over the back and flanks. Keep the pose, the head, the legs, the smooth skin everywhere else, the background and everything else the same.

spark_open.description: The creature is a low, quadrupedal animal shown in right-facing profile standing on a small patch of bare ground with sparse grass and leaves. It has a broad, flat, amphibian-like head with large round eyes and a wide, slightly upturned mouth, six feathery external gills projecting from the sides of the head and neck, a stout body with a pale, vertically ridged underbelly and a continuous dorsal covering of large overlapping brown-gray scales that extends from the top of the head over the back and sides and onto a long, broad, flattened tail that tapers to a rounded point behind the body, and four thick, fleshy, splayed limbs ending in broad five-toed clawed feet.
